test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word.

He is one of the most __underated__ players in the team.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Underrated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"underrated"** means something or someone that is not given the deserved recognition or value. (कम आंका गया)

 
 
• **Example: **She is an underrated artist whose work is not appreciated enough.
 
 
 
• **"Underrated" **is the correct spelling of the word. (कम आंका गया)
 
 
• **Example: **He is one of the most underrated players in the team.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Underrated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Undereted** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Underreted** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Underatted** (गलत वर्तनी): This is a misspelling and does not have a meaning.
